policy.meaning: Finite measured/model point estimates only. Galaxy membership alone never supplies individual depth. A member needs its own distance or a justified disk intersection; host-envelope records remain atlas-only. Individual OGLE errors are compared with host-population extent, not only observer distance.
policy.compactHostNominalDepth: Tangent plane through host centre; unknown depth bounded by published model tidal radius. Local sky display and uncertainty-aware focus.
policy.lowZMeaning: Below z=0.002 (cz approximately 600 km/s), a nominal peculiar speed of order 300 km/s is comparable to the radial velocity. Require an explicit independent distance; this is a technical review gate, not an individual measured sigma.
